accepted.s: The Development Partnership Administration (DPA) was set up in which Ministry and in which year?
o: Ministry of Commerce and Industry in 2014
accepted.x: The Development Partnership Administration was established in the Ministry of External Affairs in 2012.
accepted.tq: Identify the institution and the ministry responsible for it.
accepted.sec: Development partnership - DPA, ITEC, EXIM Bank LoCs, grant projects

accepted.s:
With reference to the Indian Technical and Economic Cooperation (ITEC) programme, consider the following statements:
1. ITEC was launched on 15 September 1964.
2. It is primarily a training-based capacity-building programme.
3. e-ITEC is the online form of ITEC.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: ITEC was launched on 15 September 1964 as a training-based capacity-building programme, and e-ITEC is its online form.
accepted.tq: Test the date, purpose and digital counterpart together.
accepted.sec: Development partnership - DPA, ITEC, EXIM Bank LoCs, grant projects

accepted.s: The Export-Import Bank of India was established on 1 January 1982 under which legislation?
accepted.x: The Export-Import Bank of India was established on 1 January 1982 under the EXIM Bank Act, 1981.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the establishment date from the year of the enabling Act.
accepted.sec: Development partnership - DPA, ITEC, EXIM Bank LoCs, grant projects

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the function of the EXIM Bank in relation to development partnership?
o: It provides scholarships exclusively to Indian students studying abroad.
It provides only military grants to foreign governments without any trade component.
It extends concessional Lines of Credit to foreign governments for importing Indian goods and services.
It regulates all foreign exchange transactions of partner countries.
accepted.x: The EXIM Bank extends concessional Lines of Credit to foreign governments, enabling them to import Indian goods and services.
accepted.tq: Apply the institution’s stated function to a development-partnership situation.
accepted.sec: Development partnership - DPA, ITEC, EXIM Bank LoCs, grant projects

accepted.s: The headquarters of the Export-Import Bank of India is located at:
accepted.x: The headquarters of the EXIM Bank is in Mumbai.
accepted.tq: Use location-based discrimination among major financial centres.
accepted.sec: Development partnership - DPA, ITEC, EXIM Bank LoCs, grant projects

o: $1 billion Line of Credit — Central Asia
$1 billion Line of Credit — Sri Lanka

accepted.s: A Memorandum of Understanding on debt restructuring was associated with which country during the Prime Minister’s visit?

accepted.s: Operation Maitri was associated with which event?
accepted.x: Operation Maitri was conducted in response to the Nepal earthquake in 2015.
accepted.tq: Match the operation name with the disaster and year.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Vande Bharat Mission — worldwide COVID-19 repatriation, 2020
Operation Sankat Mochan — South Sudan evacuation, 2016
accepted.x: Operation Kaveri was associated with the Sudan evacuation in April 2023. The Israel evacuation in October 2023 was conducted under Operation Ajay.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped operation-country pair.

accepted.s:
Match the following operations with the associated event:

(a) Dost
(b) Kaveri
(c) Ajay
(d) Ganga

(i) Israel evacuation
(ii) Ukraine evacuation
(iii) Türkiye and Syria earthquakes
(iv) Sudan evacuation

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Dost concerned the Türkiye and Syria earthquakes; Kaveri concerned Sudan; Ajay concerned Israel; and Ganga concerned Ukraine.
accepted.tq: Start from the distinctive operation names and verify all four pairings.

accepted.s: Operation Vande Bharat Mission was launched for:
o: Worldwide repatriation of Indians during the COVID-19 period
accepted.x: The Vande Bharat Mission facilitated worldwide COVID-19 repatriation in 2020.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a worldwide repatriation mission from country-specific evacuations.

accepted.s: Vaccine Maitri, launched in January 2021, primarily refers to India’s:
o: Programme for training foreign diplomats in India
Supply of COVID-19 vaccines to other countries
Evacuation of citizens from conflict zones
Financial support for overseas infrastructure projects
accepted.x: Vaccine Maitri refers to India’s supply of COVID-19 vaccines to other countries and was launched in January 2021.
accepted.tq: Separate health diplomacy from evacuation and development-finance initiatives.

accepted.s:
Which of the following are components of the India Stack offered to partner countries through India’s DPI diplomacy?
1. Aadhaar
2. UPI
3. DigiLocker
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The India Stack referred to in DPI diplomacy includes Aadhaar, UPI and DigiLocker.
accepted.tq: Test whether the listed digital public infrastructure components belong together.

accepted.s: Which of the following best explains the soft-power significance of ICCR scholarships and ITEC/e-ITEC training?
o: They restrict foreign nationals from studying in India.
They provide military alliances with foreign countries.
They replace all Lines of Credit extended by the EXIM Bank.
They build international goodwill through education, training and people-to-people engagement.
accepted.x: ICCR scholarships and ITEC/e-ITEC training are soft-power instruments that build goodwill through education, capacity building and people-to-people links.
accepted.tq: Apply the concept of soft power to education and training programmes.
accepted.sec: Scholarships and training - ICCR, Study in India, e-ITEC

accepted.s: Study in India is a programme of which Ministry and was launched in which year?
o: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, 2020
accepted.x: Study in India is a Ministry of Education programme launched in 2018 to attract foreign students.
accepted.tq: Pair the programme with its ministry and launch year.
accepted.sec: Scholarships and training - ICCR, Study in India, e-ITEC

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: ICCR scholarships — soft-power engagement with foreign nationals
Study in India — EXIM Bank concessional lending
accepted.x: ICCR scholarships are a soft-power instrument for engagement with foreign nationals. The other pairs confuse scholarships, training, development administration and evacuation functions.
accepted.tq: Reject options that assign an institution another programme’s function.

accepted.s: In the context of India’s contribution to United Nations peacekeeping, which statement is correct?
o: Korea in 1950 marked India’s first peacekeeping contribution.
Liberia in 2003 marked India’s first peacekeeping contribution.
South Sudan in 2016 marked India’s first peacekeeping contribution.
Nepal in 2015 marked India’s first peacekeeping contribution.
accepted.x: Korea in 1950 was India’s first contribution to UN peacekeeping.
accepted.tq: Use the first-in-time clue to distinguish the earliest contribution.

accepted.s: Liberia is associated with which milestone in United Nations peacekeeping?
o: The first all-women Formed Police Unit
India’s first EXIM Bank Line of Credit
accepted.x: Liberia was the location of the first all-women Formed Police Unit in UN peacekeeping.
accepted.tq: Identify the distinctive first associated with a country.

accepted.s: The first Pravasi Bharatiya Divas was held in:
accepted.x: The first Pravasi Bharatiya Divas was held in 2003.
accepted.tq: Recall the milestone year from a set of close chronological options.

accepted.s: A report of 2026 referred to how many UN Medals for Indian peacekeepers in UNMISS?
accepted.x: The reported figure was 210 UN Medals for Indian peacekeepers serving in UNMISS.
accepted.tq: Check the exact quantitative figure rather than the broader peacekeeping association.

accepted.s: The Prime Minister’s 2026 diaspora visits referred to in the context of current relevance included which two countries?
accepted.x: The visits referred to were to the Indian diaspora in the Netherlands and Australia in 2026.
accepted.tq: Pair the two locations rather than selecting a single diaspora destination.

accepted.s: The World Bank’s new Country Partnership Framework referred to in the current-affairs context covers which period?
accepted.x: The new World Bank Country Partnership Framework covers the period 2026–31.
accepted.tq: Distinguish adjacent five-year policy periods.

accepted.s: Which statement best reflects the distinction between recognition and strategic alignment in diaspora diplomacy?
o: Strategic alignment is possible only when diaspora groups are excluded from domestic politics.
Recognition and strategic alignment are identical concepts in international relations.
Recognition of diaspora contributions does not by itself amount to strategic alignment.
Recognition of a diaspora community necessarily establishes strategic alignment with its host country.
accepted.x: Recognition of a diaspora community or its contribution is not the same as strategic alignment with the host country.
accepted.tq: Separate symbolic recognition from a broader strategic relationship.

accepted.s: In the Australian context, the Indian diaspora may be recast in domestic politics as:
accepted.x: The diaspora may be portrayed as a liability in Australian domestic political debates.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise political framing rather than a diplomatic institution or programme.
